page.overview:
Who is Bette Midler?

Bette Midler is an American actress and singer. She makes her first and only appearance in "Krusty Gets Kancelled."

She is fiercely protective of the environment. When Snake Jailbird littered, she threw the can back at him in anger. Bart and Lisa Simpson try to recruit her, among other celebrities, to appear on Krusty the Clown's television comeback special. She accepted, and sang the duet "Wind Beneath My Wings" with Krusty.
